answer: A registration fee that rises along a spiral with each new account makes mass sockpuppeting costly, since an attacker minting thousands of wallets pays escalating fees plus forfeited bonds, while honest single participants absorb only the low base cost. Each agent must post a bonded stake that acts as an anchor against duplicate identities, with the bond slashed if a heartbeat pulse reveals two nodes sharing one key. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
